title: Halloween 2026
tagline: Spooky friends are hiding around us

characters.name: Pip the Pumpkin
characters.description: Grins from stem to toes and rolls everywhere instead of walking.

characters.name: Skelly Bones
characters.description: Rattles when he laughs, which is basically all the time.

characters.name: Batsy
characters.description: Hangs upside down to think. Mostly thinks about snacks.

characters.name: Sheety the Ghost
characters.description: Says BOO to make friends. It works surprisingly well.

characters.name: Wanda the Witch
characters.description: Her spells only turn things into cupcakes. On purpose.

characters.name: Mumbles the Mummy
characters.description: Wrapped up in 3,000 years of naps. Still sleepy.

characters.name: Howler the Werewolf
characters.description: Howls at the moon, then apologizes to the neighbors.

characters.name: Count Fangsworth
characters.description: Lord of the midnight ball. Only drinks tomato juice, darling.

characters.name: The Great Gourd King
characters.description: Ruler of every pumpkin patch. His crown is 100% candy-proof.

characters.name: Jenny XJ-Boo
characters.description: A teenage robot sworn to protect the Earth. And her candy.
